title: Fairness and incentives in combinatorial assignment
abstract: arXiv:2611.31557v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We consider the fair and efficient random assignment of indivisible goods subject to resource constraints. Agents receive bundles randomly, but individual lotteries over bundles that are feasible in expectation need not be jointly feasible. Consequently, we treat a lottery over feasible allocations as a public good. We show that every feasible finite economy admits an envy-free and Pareto efficient random assignment that may be supported as a Lindahl equilibrium. For a finite type space with specified expected utilities, we construct a mechanism whose outcomes are exactly feasible and Pareto efficient with respect to reported preferences. As the population grows and empirical type proportions and per-capita resources approach a limiting large economy, envy and gains from manipulation vanish. translated_title: 组合分配中的公平性与激励
translated_abstract: 我们研究在资源约束下不可分物品的公平且有效的随机分配问题。参与者随机地获得物品束，但在期望意义下可行的个体彩票（物品束上的概率分布）未必能共同实现。因此，我们将可行分配上的彩票视为一种公共物品。我们证明，每个可行的有限经济都存在一个无嫉妒且帕累托有效的随机分配，该分配可以由林达尔均衡（Lindahl equilibrium）来支撑。对于具有给定期望效用的有限类型空间，我们构造了一个机制，其结果相对于报告的偏好是精确可行且帕累托有效的。当人口规模增长、经验类型比例和人均资源趋近于某个极限大型经济时，嫉妒与操纵所带来的收益会消失。该机制的近似激励相容性对所有近似于该极限经济的类型组合均成立。
tldr: 该论文将可行分配上的彩票视为公共物品，证明了每个有限经济都存在可由林达尔均衡支撑的无嫉妒且帕累托有效的随机分配，并构造了一种在大规模经济中嫉妒与操纵激励趋于消失的近似激励相容机制。
en_tdlr: This paper treats lotteries over feasible allocations as public goods, proves that every feasible finite economy admits an envy-free and Pareto efficient random assignment supportable as a Lindahl equilibrium, and constructs an approximately incentive compatible mechanism whose envy and manipulation gains vanish in large economies.
